title: Tres Treinta y Seis
style: Phonk-infused bilingual pop with a swaggering half-time groove, pitched-up 2-bar intro engine revs, rolling hats and dry sub pulses; verse stays lean and close-mic, pre-chorus lifts with stacked Spanish/Portuguese chant doubles, chorus opens into a wide trio hook with call-and-response ad-libs, bridge drops to bare voice and low kick before the final lift. Glossy, punchy mix with gritty low-end, short delay throws, and ear-candy hat rolls into every section change., indie pop, singer-songwriter, minimal, warm, pop, light
lyrics:
[Intro]
engine rev pitched
2 bars

[Verse 1]
we don t farm pain
we don t farm tears
we upload joy
across the years

vds one sixty one
the engine s warm
night ride glow
through the data storm

[Pre-Chorus]
alegria nao e acidente
joy upload direto na gente
tres trinta y seis batendo no peito
sem trauma sem dor esse e o jeito

[Chorus]
joy upload
carga de alegria
alegria total
if it moves your chest

joy upload
cien por ciento
cem por cento real
from my chest to your content

[Verse 2]
no cosechamos dolor
ni lagrimas robadas
cosechamos lo mejor
de las jornadas

si tu corazon grita
sueltalo en sonido
deja que el latido
suba encendido

[Bridge]
minimal
every culture got a word for light
same brainwave when the chord hits right

three tongues
one frequency
one road
hit that joy upload

[Final Chorus]
joy upload
alegria alegria
hundred percent
cem por cento

cien por ciento
three thirty six
the engine sings
no trauma just joy

joy upload
carga de alegria
if it moves your chest
it qualifies

[Outro]
engine rev fade
joy alegria alegria
upload carregar cargar
three thirty six ride
